# Awesome Antigravity Tools

> Strictly curated, schema-validated directory of 100% Google Antigravity-exclusive engineering tools, IDE extensions, runtime hotfixes, and ACP gateways.

- **Canonical Repository**: https://github.com/wllzhang/awesome-antigravity-tools

- **RSS Feed**: https://wllzhang.github.io/awesome-antigravity-tools/feed.xml

## Official CLI & SDKs (3)

First-party command-line harnesses, SDKs, and official plugins maintained by Google (`google-antigravity` and `google-deepmind`) for terminal workflows and programmatic agent orchestration.

- [antigravity-sdk-python](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-sdk-python) (`google-antigravity/antigravity-sdk-python` | HEALTHY 97/100 | ★4,277 | Cross-Platform): Official Apache-2.0 Python SDK for building programmatic AI agents and workflows powered directly by Google Antigravity. Exclusivity: Official Python client library purpose-built for Google Antigravity's agent runtime. Tags: Official, Python, SDK.
  - Install: `pip install antigravity-sdk (check repo README for exact package name)`
- [antigravity-cli](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli) (`google-antigravity/antigravity-cli` | HEALTHY 84/100 | ★3,214 | Windows, macOS, Linux): Official Antigravity CLI (`agy`) bringing the reasoning, execution, and orchestration capabilities of the Antigravity agent harness directly into the terminal. Exclusivity: First-party official CLI harness for Google Antigravity (`agy` and `agy acp`). Tags: Official, CLI, Terminal.
  - Install: `Follow official installer instructions in google-antigravity/antigravity-cli`
- [robotics-antigravity-plugin](https://github.com/google-deepmind/robotics-antigravity-plugin) (`google-deepmind/robotics-antigravity-plugin` | HEALTHY 93/100 | ★421 | Linux, macOS, Cross-Platform): Official Google DeepMind Antigravity plugin suite providing Python tooling and workflows for MuJoCo simulation and real-world agentic robotics. Exclusivity: First-party Google DeepMind repository packaged specifically around Antigravity's native plugins.json specification. Tags: Official, DeepMind, Python, Robotics, Plugin.
  - Install: `Clone repository and register via Antigravity plugins configuration per README`

## Platform Fixes & Runtime Patches (7)

System-level hotfixes, localization injectors, network bridges, and patches solving core Antigravity bugs and OS runtime limitations.

- [antigravity-proxy](https://github.com/yuaotian/antigravity-proxy) (`yuaotian/antigravity-proxy` | HEALTHY 93/100 | ★6,119 | Windows, Antigravity IDE): Transparent Windows DLL-injection proxy utility that routes Antigravity process traffic through SOCKS5/HTTP proxies without requiring TUN mode. Exclusivity: Targets Antigravity's Windows child processes (including language server binaries) that ignore system proxy settings. Tags: Windows, C++, Proxy.
  - Install: `Download release package and launch Antigravity through antigravity-proxy`
- [Antigravity-Chinese-Localization](https://github.com/antigravity-cn-community/Antigravity-Chinese-Localization) (`antigravity-cn-community/Antigravity-Chinese-Localization` | HEALTHY 96/100 | ★3,564 | Windows, macOS, Linux, Antigravity IDE): MIT-licensed one-click Chinese localization toolkit and UI translation patch tailored for Google Antigravity IDE.   - Install: `Run localization script per repository README`

- [antigravity-rtl](https://github.com/mmnaderi/antigravity-rtl) (`mmnaderi/antigravity-rtl` | HEALTHY 84/100 | ★418 | Windows, macOS, Linux, Antigravity IDE): Smart Right-to-Left (RTL) layout and bidirectional typography patcher for Google Antigravity Desktop and Antigravity IDE supporting Persian, Arabic, and Hebrew.
